name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-permaculture-model-bridge
description: Local OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible SSE route, registered on the Web host's own HTTP server, that lets dsH's model picker call the n8n Permaculture Ethics & Principles Agent webhook directly: does one deterministic, non-streaming fetch to the webhook and wraps its grounded answer as a chat-completion chunk stream, since n8n's own webhook streaming mode cannot emit that wire format itself.
